name: Pridewing Venom Sac
summary: Around Mirkfallon Lake, Pridewing Venom Sacs are sought by the night elves of Astranaar. Reports suggest Horde agents harvest the poison for covert attacks, and the Sentinels mean to deny them that supply.

sections.title: A Threat in the Crags
sections.body: Pridewings hunt from the crags south of Ashenvale, especially around Mirkfallon Lake. These airborne predators are native to the Stonetalon Mountains, and their venom can be gathered from the glands in their bodies. Reports from Theramore suggest Horde assassins are taking that poison to coat blades for covert attacks on night elf settlements. In Astranaar, Sentinels send scouts to hunt the wyverns and collect their venom glands before Horde agents can claim them.

faq.q: What creatures yield a Pridewing Venom Sac?
aliases: where to get pridewing venom sac
faq.answer: Young pridewings, skyhunters, patriarchs, and consorts around Mirkfallon Lake yield the venom sacs.

faq.q: Why does Astranaar want Pridewing Venom Sacs?
faq.answer: Shindrell Swiftfire received reports that Horde agents use pridewing poison on weapons for silent attacks against the Alliance. Confiscating or destroying the glands can prevent those strikes.

faq.q: Who accepts these venom sacs in Ashenvale?
faq.answer: Shindrell Swiftfire collects the venom sacs in Astranaar, the night elf town in Ashenvale, to protect her people from covert attacks.

faq.q: Are the pridewings naturally allied with the Horde?
faq.answer: No. The pridewings around Mirkfallon Lake are wild beasts, not willing allies of the Horde. Orc agents exploit their venom for warfare.

angles.text: Denying Horde agents pridewing venom helps protect frontier patrols from unseen assassins along the contested borders of Stonetalon and Ashenvale.
As a night elf, you may regret that innocent wild beasts must be hunted, but protecting elven lives from poisoned blades comes first.
